## 简体中文

- 修复 Sempre 一键更新：接受发布元数据中的标准 SHA-256 摘要；直连 GitHub 下载失败时，会通过当前运行 Core 的本地 HTTP 代理重试。
- 新增完整的可视化更新流程，按准备、下载、校验、安装和完成展示当前步骤；下载阶段显示已下载大小、总大小、速度和预计剩余时间，更新完成后保留确认界面，由用户主动重新登录。
- 更新 Sempre 服务后会自动识别驻留的旧版 Web 界面并刷新，避免后台已经升级但页面仍显示旧版本。
- 网络测试新增节点测试页：支持逐节点延迟探活与颜色反馈，并通过绑定指定节点的隔离 Core 实例执行百度和 Google 的 DoH、HTTP 实际流量诊断，展示每一步耗时、DNS 应答、HTTP 状态和响应长度；测试不会切换当前代理节点。
- 自定义节点支持拖拽排序，顺序会持久保存并严格校验，刷新后保持一致。

## English

- Fixed one-click Sempre updates by accepting standard SHA-256 digests from release metadata and retrying failed direct GitHub downloads through the running Core's local HTTP proxy.
- Added a complete visual update flow covering preparation, download, verification, installation, and completion. Downloads show transferred and total bytes, speed, and ETA; the completion view remains visible until the user chooses to sign in again.
- The resident Web UI now detects a service version change after an update and reloads automatically instead of continuing to display the old version.
- Added a node-testing page with per-node liveness latency and color feedback. Full diagnostics run Baidu and Google DoH and HTTP traffic through an isolated Core instance pinned to the selected node, showing step duration, DNS answers, HTTP status, and response length without changing the active proxy selection.
- Added persistent drag-and-drop ordering for custom nodes with exact-order validation, so the chosen order survives refreshes.
